title: WARP home window: add Thursday, widen to 08:00-16:00
objective: kuhy can run `warp-home on` on the work laptop at home Mon/Thu/Fri 08:00-16:00 (was Mon/Fri 09:00-15:30); the PC's clock still decides, and WARP stays blocked at home outside that window.
acceptance_criteria: warp_window.sh open succeeds only Mon/Thu/Fri 08:00:00-15:59:59 and fills warp_open with a timeout ending at 16:00; Tue/Wed/Sat/Sun stay closed (test_warp_window.sh)
warp_home.sh messages name Mon/Thu/Fri 08:00-16:00 and the 16:00 cut-off (test_warp_home.sh)
Live: on Thursday `warp-home on` from the laptop opens the PC window until 16:00 and WARP connects
out_of_scope: Install path, sudoers entry and authorized_keys forced command (unchanged)
Jail-only suites in features/lib/tests (dwm, nc_php, rpi_nc, dot_resolver_install, website_admin)
verifier: linux_configuration/features/lib/tests/test_warp_window.sh; linux_configuration/features/lib/tests/test_warp_home.sh; on the laptop: warp-home on && warp-home status
